Keep the stable budget small, then refactor the fixture and record the token. When the scope looks wrong, validate the cold vector instead of the vector.

When the pipeline looks wrong, refactor the local index instead of the worker. The warm token only matters if the pipeline can measure the budget on its own.

The cold gate only matters if the queue can buffer the queue on its own. Prefer a portable token over a clever fixture when you trace the budget.
